The Claude Platform release notes list changes to the Claude API, the client SDKs, and the Claude Console, newest first.

<Tip>
  For release notes on Claude Apps, see the [Release notes for Claude Apps in the Claude Help Center](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12138966-release-notes).

  For updates to Claude Code, see the [complete CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) in the `claude-code` repository.
</Tip>

### November 23, 2026

* A fix is live for an undercount of web searches in the [List User Activity](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/analytics/users/list) endpoint of the [Claude Enterprise Analytics API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/analytics-api). The top-level `web_search_count` did not count every search tool that Claude uses in chats, so it left out some searches. It now includes them, so it can be higher. Most of the added searches come from [Chat and Cowork unified](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/analytics-api#how-metrics-are-defined).
* The web search fix applies to data for November 17, 2026 (UTC), and later, so counts that you already pulled for those days can change. It does not recount earlier days.
* A fix is live for an undercount in the [Get Connector Usage](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/analytics/connectors/list) endpoint of the [Claude Enterprise Analytics API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/analytics-api). In chats that the [session counting change](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/release-notes/overview#analytics-api-chat-session-counting) reached, `individual_auth_distinct_user_count` and `managed_auth_distinct_user_count` left out users who used a connector. For most organizations, these counts now include most of those users. They can be higher, and can show a number where they used to be `null`.
* The connector fix applies to data for November 19, 2026 (UTC), and later, so counts that you already pulled for those days can change. It does not recount earlier days.
* On November 24, 2026, a fix for an undercount of project activity in the [Claude Enterprise Analytics API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/analytics-api) will go live. The [Get Chat Project Usage](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/analytics/apps/chat/projects/list) endpoint leaves out some messages in project chats. One example is messages sent after a chat moves into a Cowork cloud session. After the fix, it will count most of those messages. `message_count`, `distinct_conversation_count`, and `distinct_user_count` can then be higher, and more projects can appear in the results.
* The [List User Activity](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/analytics/users/list) endpoint will change in the same way when you filter by `project_id`. `message_count` and `distinct_conversation_count` can be higher, `last_activity_date` can be later, and more users can appear. Without the filter, some of these messages count in `chat_cowork_unified_metrics.sessions.message_count`. So the chat `message_count` for a user can be higher with the filter than without it.
* The project fix will apply to data for November 20, 2026 (UTC), and later, so counts that you already pulled for those days can change. It does not recount earlier days.
* We announced the deprecation of the Claude Opus 4.5 model (`claude-opus-4-5-20251101` and `claude-opus-4-5`), with retirement on the Claude API scheduled for January 22, 2027. We recommend migrating to Claude Opus 5.5. See [Migrating from Claude Opus 4.5 or earlier](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/migration-guide#migrating-from-claude-opus-45). To check which dates apply on other platforms, see [Model deprecations](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations).
* We’ve launched [Enterprise Frontier Safeguards](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/enterprise-frontier-safeguards/overview) (EFS) in beta on Claude Platform, Claude Platform on AWS, and Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed). EFS is Zero Data Retention (ZDR) for eligible organizations that use [Claude’s most capable models](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/api-and-data-retention#model-specific-data-retention-requirements). Anthropic doesn’t retain your prompts and responses. Encrypted copies of them, called Sealed Safety Data, go to a bucket in your own cloud account. A workspace on Anthropic-managed storage isn’t on EFS, because Anthropic stores that workspace’s Sealed Safety Data. To get access, see [Setup guide](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/enterprise-frontier-safeguards/setup-console).
* We’ve added two event types to [organization webhooks](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/organization-webhooks#customer-owned-storage-events), which are in beta. We send `external_storage.failed` when a bucket that you use as [customer-owned storage](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/enterprise-frontier-safeguards/customer-owned-storage) fails our daily check, and `external_storage.recovered` when it passes again.

### November 20, 2026

* The [Claude Enterprise Analytics API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/analytics-api) has a new rule for when a chat in [Chat and Cowork unified](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/analytics-api#how-metrics-are-defined) counts as a session.

  * **New rule:** A session starts the first time on a UTC day that Claude successfully runs a Bash command, creates a file, or edits a file in the chat. It ends when that day ends.
  * **Previous rule:** A chat counted as a session after it moved into a Cowork cloud session (a sandbox where Claude runs code), including on later days. Uploading some types of files could cause that move.
  * **Rollout:** The change reaches chats gradually, and existing chats can change later than new ones. Until then, a chat follows the previous rule. Activity from before then is not recounted. The API does not show which rule a chat follows.

* In [List User Activity](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/analytics/users/list), these counts can change. `chat` and `sessions` are the objects in `chat_cowork_unified_metrics`.

  * **Sessions:** `sessions.distinct_session_count` can be higher, or lower for some users.
  * **Messages:** They count in `chat` before the session starts and in `sessions` after. `message_count` can be higher or lower in each.
  * **Chats:** `chat.distinct_conversation_count` can be higher. A chat counts there on each day that it gets a message, even one that counts in `sessions`.
  * **Tool actions and file edits:** They count in `sessions` during the session. `action_count` and `file_edit_count` can be higher or lower.
  * **Connectors:** In most chats, `connectors_used_count` and `distinct_connectors_used_count` split the same way as messages. Added up across both objects, each can be higher or lower.
  * **Skills and plugins:** Their use counts in `sessions`, even on a day with no session.
  * **Artifacts:** Counts can move between `chat` and `sessions`.

* For chats that the change reached, the API does not get the names of some skills and plugins that Anthropic did not make, such as your own.

  * **List User Activity:** `distinct_skills_used_count` can leave out these skills. Added up across both objects, it can be lower.
  * **[Get Skill Usage](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/analytics/skills/list):** Spend for these skills can leave out these chats. `estimated_overage_spend` can be lower, and `attributed_list_price` can be lower or `null`.
  * **[Get Plugin Usage](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/analytics/plugins/list):** These plugins can appear under the `plugin_name` value `third-party`.

* In [Get Connector Usage](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/analytics/connectors/list), `individual_auth_distinct_user_count` and `managed_auth_distinct_user_count` can leave out some users of chats that the change reached, so they can be lower.

* Other counts from the connector, skill, and plugin usage endpoints can be higher or lower.

### November 17, 2026

* We’ve launched [Linked billing](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/oauth-apps/linked-billing) in beta with the `user-profiles-billing-2026-10-01` beta header. Your customers can now pay for the Claude usage in your app through their own Claude organization. Once a customer links their organization, set `billing_policy` on each `/v1/messages` or `/v1/chat/completions` request to choose who pays. In the Claude Console, customers can set a spend cap for your app or unlink your app. Linked billing works for customers whose organization pays Anthropic directly for API usage.

### November 16, 2026

* Text generated by Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Opus 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Claude Haiku 4.5 carries Anthropic’s text watermark on supported platforms. [How Claude marks AI-generated content](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/16266773-how-claude-marks-ai-generated-content) lists those platforms. If a request to one of these models sets `temperature`, `top_p`, or `top_k` to a non-default value, the text might not carry the watermark. See [Text watermark](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/text-watermark).
* We’ve added two event types to [organization webhooks](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/organization-webhooks#encryption-key-events), which are in beta. We send `external_key.failed` when your key management service keeps refusing a customer-managed encryption key, and `external_key.recovered` when the key works again.

### November 12, 2026

* We’ve launched [self-hosted Claude Managed Agents](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/self-hosted). You run the whole Managed Agents service, not only [self-hosted sandboxes](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/self-hosted-sandboxes), on your own infrastructure, and you store agents, sessions, and session history there. The server sends model requests to the provider that you choose, which is Anthropic by default. To request access, contact your Anthropic account team.

### November 9, 2026

* We’ve launched **Claude Fable 5.2** (`claude-fable-5-2`), built for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work. **Claude Mythos 5.2** (`claude-mythos-5-2`) offers the same capabilities only to organizations verified through Anthropic’s verification programs, such as the [Cyber Verification Program](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/14604842). Both models have a [1M token context window](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/context-windows), 128k max output tokens, and always-on [adaptive thinking](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking). They cost $8 USD per MTok of input and $40 USD per MTok of output (Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 cost $10 USD per MTok of input and $50 USD per MTok of output). Claude Fable 5.2 is available on the Claude API, [Amazon Bedrock (`bedrock-runtime`)](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-on-amazon-bedrock-legacy), [Claude Platform on AWS](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-platform-on-aws), [Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed)](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-models-on-google-cloud/anthropic-managed), [Claude Models on Google Cloud (Google managed)](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-models-on-google-cloud/google-managed), and [Claude in Microsoft Foundry](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-in-microsoft-foundry). See [What’s new in Claude Fable 5.2](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5-2/whats-new-fable-5-2) for API changes and migration guidance. For model-specific prompting patterns, see [Prompting Claude Fable 5.2](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/prompting-claude-fable-5-2).
* Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 enforce the [prefix check](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/preserved-thinking#prefix-check) for every account, whatever its age. Claude Fable 5.1 returns the error by default on accounts created on or after August 31, 2026 (see [When `prefix_mismatch_behavior` is unset](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/preserved-thinking#enforcement)). If your code edits the `system` prompt, `tools`, or an earlier message and then sends back a Claude Fable 5.2 or Claude Mythos 5.2 thinking block from a later turn, the request returns a 400 error. Before you switch, [check whether your code edits the prefix](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/fable-5-2/migration-guide#fable-5-2-preserved-thinking).
* Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 read other models’ thinking blocks on the Claude API and Claude Models on Google Cloud (Google managed). So on those platforms, a conversation that moves onto either model keeps its reasoning. The other models include Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, and Claude Haiku 5.5.
* No other model reads thinking blocks from Claude Fable 5.2 or Claude Mythos 5.2. When a conversation moves from either one to a model outside this pair, the API drops those blocks. That includes a move to Claude Opus 5.5 or Claude Fable 5.1. The request still succeeds. See [Switching models mid-conversation](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/preserved-thinking#switching-models).
* Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 support computer use through the `computer_toolset_20260801` toolset. A request that declares the earlier `computer_20251124` tool returns a 400 error on every platform except Amazon Bedrock, where the earlier tool still works. See [Migrate from `computer_20251124`](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/computer-use-tool#migrate-from-computer-20251124).
* With the [advisor tool](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/advisor-tool), which is in beta, a Claude Fable 5.2 or Claude Mythos 5.2 executor accepts only Claude Fable 5.2 or Claude Mythos 5.2 as its advisor. Any other advisor returns a 400 error, so set the advisor’s `model` to one of these two models when you move an executor to them. Every executor model accepts Claude Fable 5.2 as its advisor. See [Model compatibility](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/advisor-tool#model-compatibility).
* Both models require 30-day data retention, like Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1. They aren’t available under zero data retention unless expressly authorized by Anthropic. See [Model-specific data retention requirements](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/api-and-data-retention#model-specific-data-retention-requirements).
* Thinking blocks that Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 produce work only in the account that produced them, or in an account linked to it. See [Preserved thinking](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/preserved-thinking#account-bound-thinking).
* [Dreams](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/dreams) (research preview) now supports Claude Fable 5.2. See [Supported models](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/dreams#feature-availability).
* We’ve launched [fast mode](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/fast-mode) for Claude Fable 5.2 in Messages API requests on the Claude API. Fast mode delivers up to 2.5x higher output tokens per second, at $16 USD per MTok of input and $80 USD per MTok of output. Set `speed: "fast"` on your request, with no beta header.

### November 5, 2026

* The [Compliance API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/compliance-api) now includes Security posture data, in beta for Claude Enterprise organizations. The [Activity Feed](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/compliance-activity-feed) records changes to attestations on the **Security posture** page in claude.ai **Organization settings**. The `GET /v1/compliance/organizations/{organization_id}/security_posture` endpoint returns an organization’s current Security posture results. See [Security posture in the Compliance API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/compliance-security-posture/overview).
* You can now set up an IP allowlist for your organization in the Claude Console, in beta. Requests to covered services from addresses not on your list are refused, which limits where a leaked API key can be used. Add IPv4 and IPv6 addresses or CIDR ranges, up to 1,000 per organization. See [IP allowlisting](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/ip-allowlist) for what’s covered and how to set it up.
* You can now sign a member of your Claude Enterprise (claude.ai) organization out of Claude everywhere with the Admin API. This capability is in beta. See the [Admin API reference](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization). The member stays in the organization and can sign in again. See [Sign a member out everywhere](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/user-management#sign-a-member-out-everywhere) for the beta header and what the request doesn’t end.

### November 4, 2026

* We’ve added [error codes](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/errors#error-codes) to the SDK so you can handle one cause of an error without parsing the response body. Each API error now carries the API’s error code, message, and details, and each error code has its own exception class (in Go, a constant). To use error codes, update to the [latest version of the SDK](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/cli-sdks-libraries/overview#latest-versions). See [Handle errors](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/handle-errors).

### November 3, 2026

* Text generated by Claude Mythos 5, Claude Opus 4.7, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 carries Anthropic’s text watermark on the platforms listed in [How Claude marks AI-generated content](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/16266773-how-claude-marks-ai-generated-content). On Claude Sonnet 4.6, text generated for a request that sets `temperature`, `top_p`, or `top_k` to a non-default value might not carry it. See [Text watermark](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/text-watermark).

### November 2, 2026

* Long conversations and agent loops on the Messages API can now send smaller requests and get a lower time to first token with [message threads](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/message-threads), in beta with the `message-threads-2026-08-12` beta header. The API keeps the conversation on the server, so each later request sends only the new messages. A thread expires 5 minutes after its last request and is deleted no more than 1 hour after its last use. Message threads are available on the Claude API, [Claude Platform on AWS](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-platform-on-aws), Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed), and [Claude in Microsoft Foundry](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-in-microsoft-foundry).

### October 30, 2026

* We’ve deprecated [fast mode](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/fast-mode) for Claude Opus 4.8, with removal on November 30, 2026. After removal, requests to `claude-opus-4-8` with `speed: "fast"` will return an error. To continue using fast mode, migrate to [Claude Opus 5.5](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-5-5/migration-guide#migrating-from-claude-opus-4-8). Read more in [Fast mode model availability](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/fast-mode#supported-models).

### October 29, 2026

* We’ve launched the [Usage and Cost Analytics API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/usage-cost-analytics-api) in beta with the `analytics-usage-cost-2026-08-24` beta header. Its `/v1/organizations/analytics/usage` and `/v1/organizations/analytics/cost` endpoints report token usage and cost for Claude Console and Claude Enterprise organizations. You can filter and group results by dimensions such as model, workspace, API key, and the user or service account behind each request.
* The [Usage and Cost API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/usage-cost-api) is now a legacy API, and so are the `usage_report`, `cost_report`, `user_usage_report`, and `user_cost_report` endpoints of the [Claude Enterprise Analytics API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/analytics-api). All of them remain supported. To move an existing integration, see [Migrate from the Usage and Cost API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/usage-cost-analytics-api#migrate-from-usage-cost-api) or [Migrate from the Claude Enterprise usage and cost reports](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/usage-cost-analytics-api#migrate-from-enterprise-analytics-reports).

### October 28, 2026

* We’ve raised the [maximum request size](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/overview#request-size-limits) for the Messages API and the Token Counting API from 32 MB to 128 MB on the first-party Claude API.

### October 23, 2026

* The [Claude Tag API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/claude-tag-api) is available in beta for Claude Enterprise organizations with the `experimental-claude-tag-2026-10-21` beta header. Its `/v1/organizations/claude_tag/` endpoints read and change [Claude Tag](https://claude.com/docs/claude-tag/overview) settings on Slack channels and Slack workspaces, show which settings apply in a channel and where each comes from, and attach Access bundles. Call it with an Admin API key that your primary owner creates in claude.ai with the `read:claude_tag` or `write:claude_tag` scope. It is not available to Claude Platform (Claude Console) organizations.

### October 22, 2026

* We’ve launched [Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed)](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/claude-models-on-google-cloud/anthropic-managed), the Claude API operated by Anthropic and reached through your Google Cloud project. Google Cloud IAM controls access. Google Cloud Marketplace handles billing.
* [Fast mode](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/fast-mode) is available for Claude Opus 5.5 on Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed).

### October 21, 2026

* We’ve released API version `2026-10-21`. [Migrating to API version 2026-10-21](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21) shows how to upgrade.
* We’ve released new versions of the [client SDKs](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/cli-sdks-libraries/overview) and the [`ant` CLI](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/cli-sdks-libraries/cli/quickstart) that send API version `2026-10-21` by default: Python SDK 2.0.0, TypeScript SDK 1.0.0, C# SDK 13.0.0, Go SDK 2.0.0, Java SDK 3.0.0, PHP SDK 1.0.0, Ruby SDK 2.0.0, and `ant` CLI 2.0.0. See [Switch to 2026-10-21](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21#upgrade).
* The new SDK and CLI versions also have breaking changes that don’t depend on the API version, and they are licensed under Apache 2.0 instead of the MIT License. See [SDK and CLI changes](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/migration-2026-10-21#sdk-changes).
* We’ve added the `enforcement_status` and `enforcement_actions` fields to [user profiles](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/user-profiles), so you can see whether Anthropic has restricted or banned one of your end customers. To find the profiles that have an open restriction or ban, [list your profiles](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/user_profiles/list) with the new `enforcement_status[]` filter. See [Check whether Anthropic has restricted or banned a profile](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/user-profiles#check-whether-anthropic-has-restricted-or-banned-a-profile).

### October 20, 2026

* [Inference hooks](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/inference-hooks) are out of beta for Claude Enterprise organizations.
* We’ve launched [user profiles](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/user-profiles), so you can tell Anthropic which of your end customers each API request is for. If you operate a platform or gateway, or resell API access, a safety enforcement action can then apply to one end customer instead of your whole organization. The SDK and the `ant` CLI support the new [`/v1/user_profiles` endpoints](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/user_profiles).
* We’ve added [organization webhooks](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/organization-webhooks) to the [Admin API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/admin-api), in beta with the `webhooks-2026-10-07` beta header. Its [`/v1/organizations/webhooks` endpoints](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/webhooks) register webhook endpoints for two event types: one for when Anthropic restricts or bans one of your organization’s user profiles, and one for when the restriction or ban ends. To request access, contact your Anthropic account team.
* Organization admins can now turn off web fetch for their organization on the [**Capabilities**](https://platform.claude.com/settings/capabilities) page of the Claude Console. With web fetch off, a Messages API request that includes the web fetch tool fails with a 400 error. In a Claude Managed Agents session, `web_fetch` calls return an error result to the agent instead. With web fetch on, admins can also set allowed or blocked domains for web fetch on the same page. See [How to use web fetch](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/web-fetch-tool#how-to-use-web-fetch) and [Domain filtering](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/server-tools#domain-filtering).
* In Claude Managed Agents, the [`web_fetch` tool](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/tools#available-tools) now follows your organization’s web fetch domain restrictions set on the [**Capabilities**](https://platform.claude.com/settings/capabilities) page of the Claude Console. A URL, including one reached by a redirect, must pass both the organization’s list and the `allowed_domains` or `blocked_domains` list on the agent’s `web_fetch` tool. See [Restrict web search and web fetch domains](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/tools-web-restrictions).
* In Claude Managed Agents, sessions follow your organization’s web search settings on the [**Capabilities**](https://platform.claude.com/settings/capabilities) page of the Claude Console: the **Allow web search** setting since October 6, and its web search domain restrictions since October 14. The agent receives only the search results that both the organization’s domain restrictions and the `allowed_domains` or `blocked_domains` list on the agent’s [`web_search` tool](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/managed-agents/tools#available-tools) allow. ### July 28, 2025

* We’ve released `text_editor_20250728`, an updated text editor tool that fixes some issues from the previous versions and adds an optional `max_characters` parameter that allows you to control the truncation length when viewing large files.

### July 24, 2025

* We’ve increased [rate limits](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits) for Claude Opus 4 on the Claude API to give you more capacity to build and scale with Claude. For customers with [usage tier 1–4 rate limits](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits#rate-limits), these changes apply immediately to your account: no action needed.

### July 21, 2025

* We’ve retired the Claude 2.0, Claude 2.1, and Claude Sonnet 3 models. All requests to these models will now return an error. Read more in [Model deprecations](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations).

### July 17, 2025

* We’ve increased [rate limits](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits) for Claude Sonnet 4 on the Claude API to give you more capacity to build and scale with Claude. For customers with [usage tier 1–4 rate limits](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits#rate-limits), these changes apply immediately to your account: no action needed.

### July 3, 2025

* We’ve launched search result content blocks in beta, enabling natural citations for RAG applications. Tools can now return search results with proper source attribution, and Claude will automatically cite these sources in its responses, matching the citation quality of web search. This eliminates the need for document workarounds in custom knowledge base applications. Learn more in [Search results](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/search-results). To enable this feature, use the beta header `search-results-2025-06-09`.

### June 30, 2025

* We announced the deprecation of the Claude Opus 3 model. Read more in [Model deprecations](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations).

### June 23, 2025

* In the Console, users with the Developer role can now access the [Cost](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/cost) page. Previously, the Developer role allowed access to the [Usage](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/usage) page, but not the Cost page.

### June 11, 2025

* We’ve launched [fine-grained tool streaming](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/fine-grained-tool-streaming) in beta, a feature that enables Claude to stream tool use parameters without buffering or JSON validation. To enable fine-grained tool streaming, use the [beta header](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta-headers) `fine-grained-tool-streaming-2025-05-14`.

### May 22, 2025

* We’ve launched [Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-4), our latest models with extended thinking capabilities. Learn more in [Models overview](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/overview).
* The default behavior of [extended thinking](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/extended-thinking) in Claude 4 models returns a summary of Claude’s full thinking process, with the full thinking encrypted and returned in the `signature` field of `thinking` block output.
* We’ve launched [interleaved thinking](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/thinking#interleaved-thinking) in beta, a feature that enables Claude to think in between tool calls. To enable interleaved thinking, use the [beta header](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta-headers) `interleaved-thinking-2025-05-14`.
* We’ve launched the [Files API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/files) in beta, enabling you to upload files and reference them in the Messages API and code execution tool.
* We’ve launched the [code execution tool](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/code-execution-tool) in beta, a tool that enables Claude to run Python code in a secure, sandboxed environment.
* We’ve launched the [MCP connector](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/mcp-connector) in beta, a feature that allows you to connect to remote MCP servers directly from the Messages API.
* To increase answer quality and decrease tool errors, we’ve changed the default value for the `top_p` [nucleus sampling](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Top-p_sampling) parameter in the Messages API from 0.999 to 0.99 for all models. To revert this change, set `top_p` to 0.999. Additionally, when extended thinking is enabled, you can now set `top_p` to values between 0.95 and 1.
* Our [Go SDK](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go) has moved from beta to its first stable release.
* We’ve added minute and hour level granularity to the [Usage](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/usage) page of Console alongside 429 error rates on the Usage page.

### May 21, 2025

* Our [Ruby SDK](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-ruby) has moved from beta to its first stable release.

### May 7, 2025

* We’ve launched a web search tool in the API, allowing Claude to access up-to-date information from the web. Learn more in [Web search tool](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/web-search-tool).

### May 1, 2025

* You must now specify cache control directly in the parent `content` block of `tool_result` and `document.source`. For backward compatibility, if the API detects cache control on the last block in `tool_result.content` or `document.source.content`, it will automatically apply that cache control to the parent block instead. Cache control on any other blocks within `tool_result.content` and `document.source.content` will result in a validation error.

### April 9, 2025

* We launched the [Ruby SDK](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-ruby) in beta.

### March 31, 2025

* Our [Java SDK](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-java) has moved from beta to its first stable release.
* We’ve moved our [Go SDK](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go) from alpha to beta.

### February 27, 2025

* We’ve added URL source blocks for images and PDFs in the Messages API. You can now reference images and PDFs directly through a URL instead of having to base64-encode them. Learn more in [Vision](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/vision) and [PDF support](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/pdf-support).
* We’ve added support for a `none` option to the `tool_choice` parameter in the Messages API that prevents Claude from calling any tools. Additionally, you’re no longer required to provide any `tools` when including `tool_use` and `tool_result` blocks.
* We’ve launched an OpenAI-compatible API endpoint, allowing you to test Claude models by changing only your API key, base URL, and model name in existing OpenAI integrations. This compatibility layer supports core chat completions functionality. Learn more in [OpenAI SDK compatibility](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/cli-sdks-libraries/libraries/openai-sdk).

### February 24, 2025

* We’ve launched [Claude Sonnet 3.7](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-3-7-sonnet), our most intelligent model yet. Claude Sonnet 3.7 can produce near-instant responses or show its extended thinking step-by-step. One model, two ways to think. Learn more about all Claude models in [Models overview](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/overview).

* We’ve added vision support to Claude Haiku 3.5, enabling the model to analyze images.

* We’ve released a token-efficient tool use implementation, improving overall performance when using tools with Claude. Learn more in [Tool use with Claude](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/overview).

* We’ve changed the default temperature in the [Console](https://console.anthropic.com/workbench) for new prompts from 0 to 1 for consistency with the default temperature in the API. Existing saved prompts are unchanged.

* We’ve released updated versions of our tools that decouple the text editor and bash tools from the computer use system prompt:

  * `bash_20250124`: Same functionality as the previous version, but independent of computer use. Does not require a beta header.
  * `text_editor_20250124`: Same functionality as the previous version, but independent of computer use. Does not require a beta header.
  * `computer_20250124`: Updated computer use tool with new command options including `hold_key`, `left_mouse_down`, `left_mouse_up`, `scroll`, `triple_click`, and `wait`. This tool requires the `computer-use-2025-01-24` beta header.

  Learn more in [Tool use with Claude](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/overview).

### February 10, 2025

* We’ve added the `anthropic-organization-id` response header to all API responses. This header provides the organization ID associated with the API key used in the request.

### January 31, 2025

* We’ve moved our [Java SDK](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-java) from alpha to beta.

### January 23, 2025

* We’ve launched the citations capability in the API, allowing Claude to provide source attribution for information. Learn more in [Citations](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/citations).
* We’ve added support for plain text documents and custom content documents in the Messages API.

### January 21, 2025

* We announced the deprecation of the Claude 2, Claude 2.1, and Claude Sonnet 3 models. Read more in [Model deprecations](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations).

### January 15, 2025

* We’ve updated [prompt caching](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching) to be easier to use. Now, when you set a cache breakpoint, we’ll automatically read from your longest previously cached prefix.
* You can now prefill Claude’s response when using tools.

### January 10, 2025

* We’ve optimized support for [prompt caching in the Message Batches API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/batch-processing#using-prompt-caching-with-message-batches) to improve cache hit rate.

### December 19, 2024

* We’ve added support for a [delete endpoint](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/messages/batches/delete) in the Message Batches API.

### December 17, 2024

* The following features are now available in the Claude API without a beta header:

  * [Models API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/models/list): Query available models, validate model IDs, and resolve [model aliases](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/model-ids-and-versions) to their canonical model IDs.
  * [Message Batches API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/batch-processing): Process large batches of messages asynchronously at 50 percent of the standard API cost.
  * [Token counting API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/token-counting): Calculate token counts for messages before sending them to Claude.
  * [Prompt caching](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching): Reduce costs by up to 90 percent and latency by up to 80 percent by caching and reusing prompt content.
  * [PDF support](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/pdf-support): Process PDFs to analyze both text and visual content within documents.

* We also released new official SDKs:

  * [Java SDK](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-java) (alpha)
  * [Go SDK](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go) (alpha)

### December 4, 2024

* We’ve added the ability to group by API key on the [Usage](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/usage) and [Cost](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/cost) pages of the [Developer Console](https://console.anthropic.com).
* We’ve added two new **Last used at** and **Cost** columns and the ability to sort by any column on the [API keys](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys) page of the [Developer Console](https://console.anthropic.com).

### November 21, 2024

* We’ve released the [Admin API](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/manage-claude/admin-api), allowing users to programmatically manage their organization’s resources.

### November 20, 2024

* We’ve updated our rate limits for the Messages API. We’ve replaced the tokens per minute rate limit with new input and output tokens per minute rate limits. Read more in [Rate limits](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/rate-limits).
* We’ve added support for [tool use](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/overview) in the [Console Workbench](https://console.anthropic.com/workbench).

### November 13, 2024

* We’ve added PDF support for all Claude Sonnet 3.5 models. Read more in [PDF support](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/pdf-support).

### November 6, 2024

* We’ve retired the Claude 1 and Instant models. Read more in [Model deprecations](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations).

### November 4, 2024

* [Claude Haiku 3.5](https://www.anthropic.com/claude/haiku) is now available on the Claude API as a text-only model.

### November 1, 2024

* We’ve added PDF support for use with the new Claude Sonnet 3.5. Read more in [PDF support](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/pdf-support).
* We’ve also added token counting, which allows you to determine the total number of tokens in a Message prior to sending it to Claude. Read more in [Token counting](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/token-counting).

### October 22, 2024

* We’ve added Anthropic-defined computer use tools to our API for use with the new Claude Sonnet 3.5. Read more in [Computer use tool](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/computer-use-tool).
* Claude Sonnet 3.5, our most intelligent model yet, just got an upgrade and is now available on the Claude API. Read more in the [Claude Sonnet documentation](https://www.anthropic.com/claude/sonnet).

### October 8, 2024

* The Message Batches API is now available in beta. Process large batches of queries asynchronously in the Claude API for 50 percent less cost. Read more in [Batch processing](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/batch-processing).
* We’ve loosened restrictions on the ordering of `user`/`assistant` turns in our Messages API. Consecutive `user`/`assistant` messages will be combined into a single message instead of erroring, and we no longer require the first input message to be a `user` message.
* We’ve deprecated the Build and Scale plans in favor of a standard feature suite (formerly referred to as Build), along with additional features that are available through sales. Read more in our [API pricing information](https://claude.com/platform/api).

### October 3, 2024

* We’ve added the ability to disable parallel tool use in the API. Set `disable_parallel_tool_use: true` in the `tool_choice` field to ensure that Claude uses at most one tool. Read more in [Parallel tool use](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/parallel-tool-use).

### September 10, 2024

* We’ve added Workspaces to the [Developer Console](https://console.anthropic.com). Workspaces allow you to set custom spend or rate limits, group API keys, track usage by project, and control access with user roles. Read more in our [Workspaces blog post](https://www.anthropic.com/news/workspaces).

### September 4, 2024

* We announced the deprecation of the Claude 1 models. Read more in [Model deprecations](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations).

### August 22, 2024

* We’ve added support for usage of the SDK in browsers by returning CORS headers in the API responses. Set `dangerouslyAllowBrowser: true` in the SDK instantiation to enable this feature.

### August 19, 2024

* Outputs of 8,192 tokens on Claude Sonnet 3.5 are out of beta and no longer require the `max-tokens-3-5-sonnet-2024-07-15` header.

### August 14, 2024

* [Prompt caching](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching) is now available as a beta feature in the Claude API. Cache and reuse prompts to reduce latency by up to 80 percent and costs by up to 90 percent.

### July 15, 2024

* Generate outputs up to 8,192 tokens in length from Claude Sonnet 3.5 with the new `anthropic-beta: max-tokens-3-5-sonnet-2024-07-15` header.

### July 9, 2024

* Automatically generate test cases for your prompts using Claude in the [Developer Console](https://console.anthropic.com).
* Compare the outputs from different prompts side by side in the new output comparison mode in the [Developer Console](https://console.anthropic.com).

### June 27, 2024

* View API usage and billing broken down by dollar amount, token count, and API keys in the new [Usage](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/usage) and [Cost](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/cost) tabs in the [Developer Console](https://console.anthropic.com).
* View your current API rate limits in the new [Rate Limits tab](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/limits) in the [Developer Console](https://console.anthropic.com).

### June 20, 2024

* [Claude Sonnet 3.5](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-3-5-sonnet), our most intelligent model yet, is now available across the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, and Vertex AI.

### May 30, 2024

* [Tool use](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/tool-use/overview) is out of beta across the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, and Vertex AI, with no beta header required.

### May 10, 2024

* Our prompt generator tool is now available in the [Developer Console](https://console.anthropic.com). The prompt generator helps you guide Claude to generate high-quality prompts tailored to your specific tasks. Read more in our [prompt generator blog post](https://www.anthropic.com/news/prompt-generator).

claude_apps_release_notes.heading: November 24, 2026
claude_apps_release_notes.text:
Monthly recap is out of beta
The monthly recap (Reflect, in Settings) is now out of beta for Free, Pro, Max, and Ultra plans on the web, Claude Desktop, and Claude for iOS and Android. Recaps can now draw on your Claude Code sessions and Claude Cowork tasks in the cloud, and you can delete your stored recaps from the page. For more information, see See your monthly recap (https://support.claude.com/en/articles/15672559-see-your-monthly-recap).
Install artifacts as apps (beta)
You can now install an artifact that Claude makes for you as an app on your Mac or Windows computer. It gets its own window and icon, opens like any other app, and can even interact with the operating system the way any other app might. This feature is currently in beta. For more information, see Install an app as an artifact (https://support.claude.com/en/articles/18516354-install-an-artifact-as-an-app).
Send files to connected apps and save files from them (beta)
Claude can now send a file to an app you've connected, or save a file that the app offers. File transfers with connectors are rolling out gradually in beta on Pro, Max, and Ultra plans, and on Team and Enterprise plans when an owner turns them on. For more information, see Send files to connected apps and save files from them (https://support.claude.com/en/articles/18534325).

claude_apps_release_notes.heading: November 20, 2026
claude_apps_release_notes.text:
A refreshed look for Claude Mobile
A refreshed look for Claude Mobile is rolling out gradually, starting with Claude for iOS. Your chats, projects, and plan stay the same. There's nothing to turn on. Keep your app updated, and note that the new look needs iOS 26 or later.
Computer use (beta) for Team and Enterprise plans
Computer use lets Claude see a user's screen and work in the desktop apps they allow. It works in the new Claude experience in Claude Desktop, and from Claude on the web and Claude Mobile where Computer access is on. It's now available in beta on Team and Enterprise plans, and is rolling out to organizations gradually. For more information, see Set up computer use for Team and Enterprise plans (https://support.claude.com/en/articles/18483812-set-up-computer-use-for-team-and-enterprise-plans).

claude_apps_release_notes.heading: November 17, 2026
claude_apps_release_notes.text:
Choose a release channel in Claude Desktop
You can now use a release channel to set which version of Claude Desktop you get when the app updates. Stable stays the default and gets new versions less often, after more testing. Latest gets a new version about once a day, so fixes and new features reach you sooner. For more information, see Choose a release channel (https://support.claude.com/en/articles/10065433-install-claude-desktop#h_ac219b3bde).

claude_apps_release_notes.heading: November 12, 2026
claude_apps_release_notes.text:
Add Claude to your meetings
Claude Meetings is rolling out in beta on Team and Enterprise plans in Claude and Claude Desktop. You can add Claude to a Google Meet call as a visible participant that takes notes, answers questions, and builds artifacts, such as docs, whiteboards, and slides, during the call. For more information, see Use Claude Meetings (https://support.claude.com/en/articles/18325154-use-claude-meetings).

claude_apps_release_notes.heading: November 6, 2026
claude_apps_release_notes.text:
Track spend by cost code with project tags (beta)
Eligible Enterprise organizations can now tag projects with the codes they already use, like a charge code or client-matter number, and see most spend in those projects by tag. This feature is available in beta. For more information, see Track spend by cost code with project tags (https://support.claude.com/en/articles/18251257-track-spend-by-project-with-tags).

claude_code.body:
## What's changed

- Added a trust dialog warning that says where a folder's hooks are declared
- Added a warning in the conversation, in Claude Desktop and other non-interactive hosts, when hooks in managed settings fail to load
